parsed.name: HP 8903B 音频分析仪
parsed.description: HP 8903B 是一台 20 Hz 至 100 kHz 的台式音频分析仪，用于实验室和电子测试中对音频信号及相关设备进行测量与性能评估。
parsed.description_en: The HP 8903B is a bench-top audio analyzer covering 20 Hz to 100 kHz, used in laboratories and electronics test setups to measure and evaluate audio signals and related equipment.

actions.description: 发送查询命令并读取仪器返回信息。
actions.description_en: Send a query command to the instrument and read back its response.
